body:
Bounded scope-completion follow-up to W06-S1217-INFO-004, independently checked against published W06 `82dce85aea7810941dfdf0bde7480bcdaa0c5826`. The original review classified these three cases as informational; this comment preserves that classification and does not allege an unsafe mapping. The narrower uncertainty does not prevent all useful representation.

| Case | Supported work now | Boundary retained |
|---|---|---|
| 28, polypropylene glycol 2000 | [NBRC1400](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1400) positively names PPG2000 and its 2 g medium input. Prepare a bounded nominal-polymer-grade proposal after the normal exact-term lookup. A variable polymer does not require a single molecular formula or identified supplier to be represented. | No fixed chain length, end groups, exact molecular weight, vendor product, monomer/PEG identity, or aqueous supplied stock. Supplier PPG2000 examples establish representability, not NBRC procurement. |
| 80, DI WATER | [ATCC2686](https://www.atcc.org/~/media/ED2F144D72B749E9B32F46C366F07F69.ashx) names DI water in the main medium and distilled water in nested stocks. Reconcile this source occurrence with W08's already-published `if1201-new-deionized_water` proposal at `b90a2fd4681d20e2586481b7b9b1114a78281b94`, preserving both cases. | No second source-number-specific owner, no exact alias on Distilled_Water, no invented purity/resistivity/sterility, and no claim that the frozen 1 G_PER_L is the source's 1 L. #470 remains applicable. |
| 112, Trace-metal mix A5 | [TOGO M2499](https://togomedium.org/sparqlist/api/gmdb_medium_by_gmid?gm_id=M2499) permits a literal seven-input source representation, including `CuSO2·5H2O` as an UNMAPPED component. COMPLETE may describe the whole printed immediate list; it does not mean copper identity is resolved. | Do not silently normalize copper to sulfate or mint a duplicate owner because of the typo. Existing `Trace_Metal_Mix_A5.yaml` / `MICRO:0001349` already has this source recipe, CultureMech:009072, in maintained membership, plus other BG11 history. Exact source-to-owner/formulation continuity remains an application hold. If no owner payload can express that boundary safely, retain a held source-bound component proposal and explicit decision rather than declaring the positive list unrepresentable. |

For A5, the existing ontology definition and nearby proposals are comparison evidence, not permission to overwrite the source: M2601 explicitly uses deionized water, ATCC957 prints 0.039 g rather than 0.39 g sodium molybdate dihydrate, and JCM1419 changes manganese amount and cobalt salt. Missing or erroneous copper text proves neither equality nor a new distinct substance. Preserve the source's stock dose, printed concentration units, added-water basis, original history, and all occurrence identities.

Private proof packet: `preflight/w06-info004-feasibility-v1` under the durable campaign directory. It pins all three decisions/source cases, primary bytes and original retrieval times, current catalogue and relevant published proposals. No candidate, maintained record, approval status or export was changed. Any successor requires independent review and the usual guarded integration gates.
